text:
maya: Drafting a concise customer-facing runbook for Acme (mid-market).
Goals: reduce renewal risk in first 90 days, surface health signals early, and give CS a clear playbook for prefill/warm pools, batching knobs, and streaming fallbacks. Uploaded a sketch: https://drive.redwood/acme-runbook-draft

allen: Quick q — expected peak QPS / demo spikes?

maya: Peak steady 50-100 QPS, demo spikes to ~300 QPS for ~10-15min. We'll target warm pools + selective tenant prefill for their top flows.

jordan: For that profile: recommend batching window = 20ms, max_batch_size = 64. Enable tenant KV prefix cache with TTL = 6h. Streaming fallback: start streaming at first token if model latency > 180ms p50. Snippet:

```
# runtime config (example)
batching:
  window_ms: 20
  max_batch: 64
cache:
  prefix_kv:
    enabled: true
    ttl_hours: 6
streaming_fallback:
  enable: true
  latency_threshold_ms: 180
  fallback_model: smaller-variant-v1
```

sam: Add a canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback/fallback to smaller-variant if latency p50 > 250ms for 5m. Instrument metrics: `redwood.api.response_time`, `redwood.cache.hit_rate`, `redwood.requests.per_tenant`.

lina: Also add a short CS warm-up script we can ask customers to run before demos. e.g.:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prompts":["welcome","faq","demo_prompt"]}'
```

maya: Perfect. Action items:
- allen: run the demo warm-up for the trial account next Tue and confirm hit_rate >= 0.75 after warmup
- jordan: create dashboard with p50/p95 latency, cache.hit_rate, and requests/per_tenant; add alert if p50 > 250ms or cache.hit_rate < 0.6
- sam: add canary rollout steps to the runbook and config snippets for fallback

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created for dashboard request (assignee: jordan).

jordan: Ack — will have dashboard up in ~24h. Also proposing a renewal-risk micro-play: if DAU drops >30% week-over-week AND query latency up >20% then escalate to AM + SE.

allen: Ill prepare the feedback capture template — monthly NPS plus a 2-week in-app micro survey. Will share to this thread.

maya: I'll stitch everything into the customer-facing one-pager and send the final runbook by Thu EOD. Draft checklist below for quick copy:

```
RUNBOOK CHECKLIST - Acme (first 90 days)
1) Preflight (day -7 to 0):
   - Run warm-up script for top 10 prompts
   - Verify cache.hit_rate >= 0.7
   - Ensure warm pool allocated (min 2 servers)
2) Go-live (day 0-14):
   - Enable batching (window 20ms, max 64)
   - Streaming fallback ON (threshold 180ms)
   - Start canary rollout (5%) with telemetry monitoring
3) Stabilize (day 15-30):
   - Ramp canary 25% -> 100% if p50<250ms
   - Monitor `redwood.cache.hit_rate` and `redwood.api.response_time`
4) Feedback & Renewal signals:
   - Send 2-week micro-survey, monthly NPS
   - If DAU drop >30% w/w AND latency +20% -> escalate to AM/SE
5) Escalation steps:
   - Revert to smaller-variant or enable aggressive caching
   - CS to schedule joint triage call with eng within 24h

Quick commands:
- Warm-up curl (see above)
- Telemetry query (example):
  `metrics.query("avg(redwood.api.response_time{tenant=\"acme\"}, '5m')")`
```

maya: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when youve completed your action items and I'll post the final runbook here.
